name: Queue Implementation
description: Implements a queue (FIFO) data structure with enqueue, dequeue, and front operations using an array with front/rear pointers or a linked list.
aim: Provide FIFO (First-In-First-Out) access: enqueue adds to rear, dequeue removes from front, all in O(1) time.
howItWorks: Circular array: front and rear pointers with modulo wrapping

time.bestCase: All operations constant time with circular array

realWorld: Print spooler — first job in, first printed
alternatives: Priority queue — when order based on priority not arrival
